request.description:
Creates a new trouble ticket following TMF621 standards. This endpoint replicates the functionality of the original CreateFaultRequestV2UAT while adhering to TM Forum TMF621 specification v4.0.0.

**Required TMF621 Fields:**
- status: new, acknowledged, pending, resolved, closed
- severity: critical, major, minor, warning
- category: Issue category
- description: Issue description
- relatedParty: Array of related parties (minimum 1)

**SLT-Specific Fields (mapped from original API):**
- serviceID: SLT service identifier
- faultyTelephoneNo: Faulty telephone number
- serviceOption: Service type (BB, etc.)
- natureOfFault: Fault nature code
- testObservation: Test observations

**Response:** HTTP 201 with created trouble ticket data
